name: Shwepyi Nann Thanaka Chandon Pudding Face Cream 25ml
description:
Shwepyi Nann Thanaka Chandon Pudding Face Cream – 25ml

Experience the natural skincare secret of Myanmar with the Shwepyi Nann Thanaka Chandon Pudding Face Cream. This 25ml cream is enriched with Thanaka, a traditional ingredient renowned for its skin-brightening and anti-inflammatory properties.

Key Features & Benefits:

Natural Brightening: Helps enhance skin tone and radiance.

Soothes & Protects: Reduces inflammation and calms the skin.

Hydrating & Nourishing: Keeps skin soft, smooth, and well-moisturized.

Compact & Portable: Perfect for use at home or on-the-go.

Made in Myanmar: Crafted with authentic Thanaka for trusted traditional skincare.

Ideal for daily use, this pudding face cream improves skin texture, providing a healthy, glowing complexion wherever you are.
